reviewed_by: Claude Code, at the operator's request: show a partial head/tail preview for large command output instead of nothing
reason: Command receipts inlined output only when all of it fit 4 KiB; larger output gave the model nothing but artifact references, so about 30% of commands cost an extra tool_output.read round trip (49,242 preview-less results and 23,083 reads on live Core over 3 days). command_output_preview (tool_results.py) now keeps the complete small preview and otherwise gives each stream a redacted head and tail, marked partial with total_lines, total_bytes and the omitted line range, shrunk until the whole receipt fits MAX_EXCERPT_BYTES. Redaction runs over whole lines (a single over-long line is redacted before it is cut), and an unmatched private-key marker stops the head or tail before possible key material. Both command receipt builders (tools.py broker, automation_tools.py run_command) use it off the event loop; partial receipts keep tool_output.search/read in next_actions; failure context keeps the tail of a partial preview. tool_output.read's default and maximum page go from 100/200 to 400 lines, still bounded by 8 KiB. Model guidance (chat tool instructions, harness gateway description) names partial previews. Selected: the new focused unit tests, the automation-runtime receipt tests, and the receipt/failure suites that build or read output_preview (tool failures, all-tool failure guidance, storage waste, never policy, tool-result recovery, minimal instructions).
exclusions: Not selected because they fail identically on pristine origin/main d497cb2 (verified by running them with the source changes removed): tests/v3/test_automation_runtime.py::test_network_request_fails_closed_when_disabled_or_scope_is_url_only (DID NOT RAISE AutomationPolicyDenied), ::test_host_mode_requires_consent_and_reads_external_folder_without_docker (AutomationRuntimeUnavailable: prepare the existing Kali headless runtime), ::test_temporary_host_override_accepts_chat_origin_harness_only (DID NOT RAISE MemoryEnforcementUnavailable), ::test_host_scope_expiry_closes_running_commands (session ready, expected closed), and tests/v3/test_harnesses.py::test_knowledge_access_change_refreshes_fixed_gateway_catalog (HarnessInstructionContextChanged). The rest of test_automation_runtime.py, test_chat_tool_loop.py, test_process_results_webhook.py, test_tool_history_memory.py, test_browser_companion.py and test_in_turn_context_pruning.py were run locally and pass but are not selected: they do not depend on the preview size. No UI change: the UI's output_preview is the unrelated terminal-history field. No LAN Core run: the change is a model-facing receipt format exercised directly by the broker tests.
